title: scratch_bus.launch leaves its bus and the bus's children alive past shutdown on Windows
intention: When a scratch_bus.launch() block exits, every process it started is already gone (the bus and anything the bus woke under the scratch HOME), so the scratch sweep never has to end one.
why: Measured 2026-11-17 on akienlivingroom (Windows 11): when a launch('codemother') block exited, the scratch sweep printed 'outlived its run ... ended it' three times: two pythonw 'bus serve' processes and one ground_loop, all under that block's scratch dirs. The proof stays green only because the safety net reaps what the tool left behind.
traces_to: Law 7 (errors are loud): the leak is loud only because the sweep exists. Law 8: a green that depends on a reaper hides a defect from the peers that lean on it.
how: After RemoteBus.shutdown(), launch() waits (polling at 0.1 s, bounded at 30 s) until nothing holds the block's scratch HOME or bus address, then lets scratch_dir sweep them. If the wait times out it raises, naming the pids. If the red-first proof shows the bus server never ends the ground_loop it woke, the bus machine's serve shutdown ends its children before exiting.

clauses.claim: after a normal exit from 'with launch("codemother")', no process holds that block's scratch HOME or bus address, so the sweep ends nothing for those dirs
the block's exit, shutdown included, finishes within 30 s
if something still holds the dirs when the wait ends, launch() raises naming the pids rather than returning quietly

decisions.text: D1: launch() waits after shutdown for the HOME and address holders to be gone, bounded, and raises on timeout. The sweep stays the only killer.
D2: a red-first proof with one tooth per clause, run under PYTHONPATH=. with the venv python.

out: cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py (the sweep stays as it is)
every other component; the bus machine's serve shutdown is touched only if the proof shows it never ends its children, and then it is recorded in this voyage

measured.saw: the scratch sweep ended pids 6988 and 2660 (pythonw -m cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus serve --home ...bus-scratch.0-11012-...) and 4784 (pythonw -m cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop under launch-codemother-scratch.0-11012-...) after the block had exited with rc 0
measured.how: PYTHONPATH=. venv python: 'with launch("codemother"): ...' on akienlivingroom, reading the sweep's stderr
